_readme: Normalisation applied by scripts/extract_clinvar.py and app/clinvar/parse.py. Matching is case-insensitive on the trimmed ClinicalSignificance string. Anything not listed maps to OTHER.
submitter_id: lowercase the Submitter string, replace every run of characters outside [a-z0-9] with '-', strip leading and trailing '-', truncate to 80 characters
change_kind_rules: computed in Cypher by K5 (see docs/queries.cypher); listed here for reference: NEEDS_REVIEW_CLASS if either class is CONFLICTING or OTHER; UP_TO_ACTIONABLE if not P/LP -> P/LP; DOWN_FROM_ACTIONABLE if P/LP -> not P/LP; VUS_RESOLVED_BENIGN if VUS -> LB/B; BENIGN_TO_VUS if LB/B -> VUS; otherwise WITHIN_TIER
